Title: Public preview: Discovery and assessment for ASP.NET web apps with Azure Migrate

Body.Content:
Azure Migrate’s unified discovery and assessment capabilities for servers, databases, and web apps now allows you to discover and assess your on-premises ASP.NET web apps running on IIS web servers at scale for migration to Azure App Service.      

Until now, you could do agentless discovery and assessment of your virtual machines and bare metal servers with Azure migrate, but you would use integrations with tools like App Service Migration Assistant to assess your web apps individually.  

With this preview capability, you can now discover .NET web apps running in your VMware environment and create assessments or migration recommendations at-scale for Azure IaaS or Azure App Service.   

Learn more: Azure Migrate discovery and assessment for ASP.NET web apps blog.  

Read the Azure Migrate documentation.
